scientific_question: When sequence clusters are held out simultaneously in all three known Mordstein contexts, does an explicit context-gated MFE model improve variant-OOD prediction over shared simple/full ridge and per-context no-transport simple/full ridge?
observed_phenomenon: RK30 source-trained cross-context transport failed all 16 primary endpoints and separate within-context structure increments failed all 12 secondary endpoints.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Pooling training clusters across known contexts while allowing context-specific deviations for the three MFE slopes yields positive whole-cluster OOD increments against every frozen simple/full and no-transport comparator. Any failed primary endpoint rejects the broad applicability-model claim.
scope: Known-context variant-OOD only. Context indicators are sequence-independent design labels. No target-context or other-context outcome from a held-out variant is used as a predictor. This is not unseen-context transport, protein-OOD, causal mechanism, velocity/decay, direct RFU or SOTA.

features.context_gating: Add each nonreference context indicator and its product with each of the three MFE features. Reference-context MFE slopes are the shared slopes; interactions are deviations for the other two contexts. Simple slopes remain shared.

arms.shared_simple: One pooled Ridge on simple features plus two context indicators.
arms.shared_full: One pooled Ridge on simple+MFE features plus two context indicators.
arms.context_gated_full: One pooled Ridge on shared_full plus six context-by-MFE interactions.
arms.no_transport_simple: A separate simple-feature Ridge for each context; no cross-context outcome pooling.
arms.no_transport_full: A separate simple+MFE-feature Ridge for each context; no cross-context outcome pooling.
arms.null: Training-fold mean within each context; descriptive absolute reference only.

primary_comparisons.effect_direction: Spearman candidate-minus-baseline; MSE baseline-minus-candidate; positive favors the candidate.
primary_comparisons.endpoint_family: 3 contexts x 4 baselines x 2 metrics, one Holm family across all 24.
primary_comparisons.gating_subset: The six context_gated_full versus shared_full endpoints isolate context-specific MFE slopes but cannot rescue failure against any simple or no-transport comparator.

outer_evaluation.fold_assignment: Reuse the frozen RK28/RK30 whole-cluster assignment algorithm and seeds. A held-out cluster is excluded from training in every context.
outer_evaluation.leakage_rule: No test-cluster outcome from any context enters fitting or scaling. Context labels are allowed; outcomes of held-out variants in other contexts are never predictors.

model.ridge: Training-fold feature and outcome mean/population-standard-deviation scaling, then sklearn Ridge(alpha=1.0, solver=cholesky), exactly as RK30. No hyperparameter search.

inference.seed_rule: At least 8 of 10 seed-level effects must be positive.
inference.endpoint_pass_rule: Observed effect>0, 95% whole-cluster bootstrap lower bound>0, family-Holm two-sided sign-swap p<0.05 and at least 8/10 positive seeds.
inference.family_pass_rule: All 24 endpoints pass. Otherwise KNOWN_CONTEXT_GATED_MFE_APPLICABILITY_NOT_SUPPORTED. Report each context and contrast separately; no universal negative mechanism claim.
